question: Who abides in me and who is not tainted?
premises: One established in unity who worships me situated in all beings abides in me even while acting in every way.
One filled with knowledge who knows the all-pervading Lord through oneness is not tainted even after passing through all states.
inference: The verse distinguishes unified worship leading to abiding in the Lord from knowledge-filled knowing leading to freedom from taint.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic scope of 'sarvabhūtasthitaṃ' with 'māṃ' is slightly ambiguous.
The compound 'so'vaśyamevaikatayā' is dense and may admit alternative parsing.
plain_english: He who, established in unity, worships me as present in all beings abides in me though acting in every way; and he who is filled with knowledge, knowing the all-pervading Lord through oneness, is not tainted though he has passed through all states.
